messages:
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline `main` failed after merge: smoke-gpu matrix (2 failures). run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/681234

ci-bot: failed steps: `smoke-gpu/alloc-check`, `smoke-gpu/kvalloc-stress`

maya: oh no — that was my merge (PR #4321) landed ~1m ago. not sure why this hit smoke, my change touched a tiny allocator lock.

jon: pinging to grab this. can someone grab quick? :eyes:

sasha: i'll take a look. initial glance at the logs shows `kvalloc` OOM-ish traces, but could be noise.

ryan: can we rerun first? if it's infra flake a rerun will tell us. i'm rerunning now.

ci-bot: rerun triggered by ryan — new run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/681235 (started)

jon: thanks. maya — can you confirm the PR diff? did it change any allocation defaults or test-time flags?

maya: only change was switching a lock to `std::shared_mutex` in allocator.cc and a tiny doc tweak. no config changes.

sasha: shared_mutex could change contention pattern under stress. might surface in smoke which uses concurrent small allocations. if rerun is red again we should consider a quick revert.

ryan: rerun is still in progress. if it fails i'll try invoking the flaky-retry job (3x) to see pass rate.

ci-bot: rerun completed: FAIL (same steps failed).

jon: ok reproducible on CI. maya please prepare a revert PR so we can get main green. if it's small I can submit the revert.

maya: on it — creating revert now. will tag reviewers and mark as hot-revert.

sasha: parallel action: i'm bisecting locally against your change to confirm causality. sharing quick repro steps soon.

eng-oncall-bot: Notifying oncall rotation for infra: @eng-infra-oncall (pager) — potential cluster pressure observed in smoke region us-west-2.

ryan: good call. sasha, if you can reproduce locally that seals it. otherwise we'll revert to restore SLO.

sasha: repro looks consistent: small test harness that spawns 64 threads doing malloc/free hits `kvalloc-stress` failure within 30s with your lock change applied. rolling back locally makes it stable.

jon: that's our signal. maya thanks — revert when ready and i'll merge asap. also add a follow-up ticket to investigate lock upgrade semantics under high concurrency.

maya: revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4322 — cc @jon for quick merge. adding note to link follow-up ticket. sorry for the churn, team. :pray:

jon: merging revert now.

ci-bot: revert merged, new pipeline triggered: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/681236

ci-bot: pipeline `main` now: PASS ✅

ryan: thanks all. filing postmortem note: small allocator lock change caused contention under smoke load. follow-up: add a smoke regression test that exercises high allocation concurrency.

maya: will open the follow-up ticket and a small perf test. thanks for the fast help everyone. :thumbsup:
